posts.title: I grew a garlic!
posts.description: I grew a garlic! Turns out: if you have a garlic bulb that grows a little green sprout, and you stick it in the ground, it will grow into multiple bulbs! (Each clove grows into ~1 bulb, apparently it’s better to plan them separately)
